text:
Anya: quick check-in on pin TTL + affinity semantics in rollout metadata. noticed a couple of edgecases during the canary that I want to align on before we finalize schema v3.

Anya: concrete problems: 1) TTL-based eviction + long-lived client sessions -> client pins a model, server auto-evicts after TTL, client keeps asking for a pinned model id that no longer resolves. 2) affinity: "session" vs "request" semantics are not explicit enough; we need a clear priority order when multiple affinity hints exist.

Sam: ack. are we sure we want TTL to be authoritative server-side? i worry about surprising failures for clients that expect pin to be indefinite unless explicitly unpinned. maybe TTL should be optional and require an explicit "evict_policy": "auto" to be set.

Mika: +1 to optional TTL. Another option: keep TTL but add a grace window and a probe mechanism so active sessions can renew the pin before eviction. e.g. metadata fields: `grace_window_seconds` and `renewal_endpoint`.

Anya: sketch of metadata I had in mind:
```json
{
  "model_pin": {
    "model_id": "open-llama-7b-v2",
    "pin_source": "api",         // api | console | autoscaler
    "ttl_seconds": 3600,          // optional
    "grace_window_seconds": 300,  // optional, client can renew
    "affinity": "session",      // session | request | tenant
    "affinity_priority": ["session","tenant","request"]
  }
}
```

Sam: that helps. question: who enforces renewals? clients or the platform? If platform enforces, we need cheap heartbeat qps accounting. if clients, we need a clear SDK contract.

Mika: SDK + server hybrid: default renewal via SDK every `ttl_seconds / 2` if `renewal_endpoint` is present. server-side fallback: if no renewal observed and `evict_policy` == `auto`, evict after `ttl + grace_window`.

Leo: small but important: rollout traces need to capture the exact `pin_source` and `rollout_signature` so we can reason about why a pin changed. propose adding a `rollout_signature` field (stable hash of relevant fields) and `applied_at` timestamp to metadata.

Zara: agree on `rollout_signature`. also think we should version the metadata (`schema_version`) so older SDKs can ignore unknown fields. otherwise clients will behave unpredictably.

Anya: good call. so minimal v3 additions: `pin_source`, `ttl_seconds` (optional), `grace_window_seconds` (optional), `affinity_priority` (ordered list), `rollout_signature`, `schema_version`. default semantics: no TTL means pin persists until explicit unpin.

infra-bot: deployment-bot: schema-migration v3 applied to staging at 2026-03-19T09:12:01Z. tests: migration, backfill, read-compat OK. :white_check_mark:

Sam: migration concerns: existing rows with `pin` null — backfill should set `schema_version = 1` and `rollout_signature = md5(config_json)` so we have deterministic fingerprints. Also we should add an index on `(model_id, schema_version)` for common queries.

Mika: here's a quick SQL prototype for backfill/index:
```
ALTER TABLE rollout_metadata ADD COLUMN schema_version int DEFAULT 1;
ALTER TABLE rollout_metadata ADD COLUMN rollout_signature text;
UPDATE rollout_metadata SET rollout_signature = md5(config_json::text) WHERE rollout_signature IS NULL;
CREATE INDEX idx_rollout_model_version ON rollout_metadata (model_id, schema_version);
```

Leo: test plan notes: 1) simulate long-lived sessions with SDK renewal, 2) simulate ill-behaved clients (no renewal) -> make sure evict policy leads to clear telemetry entries and audit logs, 3) confirm fallback path where platform routes to compatible variant when pinned model missing.

Zara: UX ask for Console: show `pin_source`, `applied_at`, and a human-readable `evict_policy`. Also surface the `rollout_signature` and a link to the exact config JSON used for that signature.

Anya: action items: @Sam write migration PR + index; @Mika update SDK to include renewal logic and default behavior; @Zara add Console mocks; @Leo add telemetry tests; I'll draft the final schema JSON + compatibility doc.

Sam: will do. aiming for PR + migration run this week.

Mika: I'll start SDK changes tomorrow, will gate behind `schema_version` checks.

Anya: thanks all. if anyone sees missing edgecases call them out now or I'll send the schema doc later today. :rocket:
